response.overview: To book a cruise on Freedom of the Seas or get reservations assistance from Royal Caribbean, call  + 1 -888-512-8367|(US * Canada). You can also browse itineraries, deck plans, and booking options directly on the Freedom of the Seas  + 1 -888-512-8367|(US * Canada) or visit Royal Caribbean Cruises for additional contact and account support.  + 1 -888-512-8367|(US * Canada) If you are looking for an existing reservation confirmation number rather than a phone number  + 1 -888-512-8367|(US * Canada) to book, check your booking confirmation email from Royal Caribbean or contact the travel agency or booking platform you used to reserve your trip
